name: Nake's Hauptweg
promptTemplate: Frieder Nake Klee homage with {{palette}} ink on textured ground, hatch spacing {{hatch_spacing}}px, jagged polyline shift {{jaggedness}}px, {{plotter_scan}} pen traversal, and {{symbol_density}} symbolic glyphs.

ui.title: Nake Plotter v1.2
ui.tagline: Algorithmic Klee homage via simulated flatbed pen plotter

palette.hint: Cycle historical paper stock and ink tones

hatch_spacing.hint: Tighten or broaden parallel ink stroke spacing

plotter_scan.hint: Set pen carriage traversal cadence across the bands

symbol_density.hint: Scatter Klee triangles, crosses, and glyphs

listing.blurb: In the spirit of Frieder Nake's homage to Paul Klee: horizontal bands divided by jagged polylines, filled with vertical hatching and scattered circles and triangles, redrawn band by band as if by a pen plotter.
listing.prompt: In the spirit of Frieder Nake's homage to Paul Klee: horizontal bands divided by jagged polylines, filled with vertical hatching and scattered circles and triangles, redrawn band by band as if by a pen plotter. Build it with a demoscener's economy: one core technique done well, lookup tables and fixed-size buffers kept in room.state, nothing allocated inside hot loops, a steady 60fps at 1920x1080, and compact, clearly named code.
